$comment: Source: one issue block from the 'History of Bond Purchases for Cancellation' XLSX linked from the outstanding amounts on the CMHC List of outstanding CHT debt issues (https://www.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/professionals/project-funding-and-mortgage-financing/securitization/canada-mortgage-bonds/list-of-outstanding-cht-debt-issues). Field semantics were confirmed against the October 15, 2026 workbook.
title: CMHC Canada Housing Trust – Outstanding History of Bond Purchases for Cancellation
description: JSON Schema for the history of bond purchases and cancellations associated with one CHT series. The source XLSX contains one block per series; each block is written as its own JSON document so it can be associated with the offering circulars for that series. Dates are ISO 8601 calendar dates and amounts are numbers in millions of Canadian dollars.

sourceUrl.description: URL or path the workbook was parsed from, when known.

title.description: Printed workbook heading, e.g. 'History of Bond Purchases for Cancellation as of October 15, 2026'.

asOfDate.description: The 'as of' date printed in the workbook heading, normalized to 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

series.description: Bond series, normalized to the debt-issues form, e.g. 'Series 77'.

identifier.description: CUSIP or ISIN from the 'CUSIP' row. Current workbooks contain nine-character CUSIPs.

cancellations.description: Cancellation periods printed for this issue, in printed order. Empty when the issue has no recorded cancellations.

coupon.description: The coupon printed for the issue, either a fixed annual rate or a floating index plus spread.

displayText.description: Printed coupon text with whitespace normalized, e.g. '2.35%', '3m CDOR -0.18%' or 'CORRA + 0.375%'.

kind.description: Normalized form of the coupon: a fixed percentage or an index plus spread.

fixedRatePercent.description: Fixed annual coupon rate in percent. Required when kind is 'fixed'.

index.description: Floating-rate index name, e.g. '3m CDOR' or 'CORRA'. Required when kind is 'floating'.

spreadPercent.description: Spread over the index in percentage points. Required when kind is 'floating'.

fromDate.description: First day of the cancellation period.

toDate.description: Last day of the cancellation period.

cancelledAmount.description: Amount cancelled during the period, in millions of Canadian dollars.
